proposals.evidence: Turner *buba explicitly gives Nepali bubā/buwā, Kumauni buwā and Oriya buā as father or an affectionate address to a father. These Nepal-region and eastern survey forms are compared with that nursery-word family, without treating the resemblance as a regular sound-law derivation from pitṛ.
